#include <iostream>

const int MOD = 998244353;

class InputReader {
    FILE *is;
    char buf[1024];
    int pos, size;
public:
    InputReader(FILE *is) : is(is), pos(0), size(0) {}
    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw 1;
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }
    int read() {
        if (size == -1) throw 1;
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), is);
            if (size <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }
    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

static void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = a.size();
    int k = 0;
    while ((1 << k) < n) k++;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = 0;
        for (int bit = 0; bit < k; bit++) {
            j = (j << 1) | ((i >> bit) & 1);
        }
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        double ang = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        double wlen_real = cos(ang);
        double wlen_imag = sin(ang);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double w_real = 1.0, w_imag = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double u_real = a[i + j];
                double u_imag = b[i + j];
                double v_real = a[i + j + halfLen] * w_real - b[i + j + halfLen] * w_imag;
                double v_imag = a[i + j + halfLen] * w_imag + b[i + j + halfLen] * w_real;
                a[i + j] = u_real + v_real;
                b[i + j] = u_imag + v_imag;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = u_real - v_real;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = u_imag - v_imag;
                double temp_real = w_real * wlen_real - w_imag * wlen_imag;
                double temp_imag = w_real * wlen_imag + w_imag * wlen_real;
                w_real = temp_real;
                w_imag = temp_imag;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

static vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 2;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    n = max(n, 2);

    vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0), aImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aReal, aImag, false);

    vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0), bImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal, bImag, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n), faImag(n), fbReal(n), fbImag(n);
    double cf = 0.25 / n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;
        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;
        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    fft(faReal, faImag, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImag, true);
    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImag[i] + 0.5);
        long long val = aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30);
        res[i] = (int)(val % mod);
        if (res[i] < 0) res[i] += mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    InputReader in(stdin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, MOD);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, MOD);
    }
    int res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (int)((res + (long long)x * x) % MOD);
    }
    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
